description:
FOR: whichever seat works pueblo-srda-questions (the Pueblo SRDA Questions demo site). Filed by Polybius the Stoagen 2026-08-22 at PRINCIPAL direction ("we always need beadworks so we can pass things to other agents, including yourself, if something goes wrong"). First ticket in this store.

WHAT THIS REPO IS. Source for https://pueblo-srda-questions.stoagen.com/ - "Pueblo SRDA Questions": an independent site built around the author's personal, transportation-first questions about the programs of SRDA (Senior Resource Development Agency, Pueblo, Colorado), with the public record laid out around them. A demonstration site created with the Stoagen system; the system's own site is https://stoagen.com/ (repo denson/stoagen-com, bw prefix sg). Local checkout on this machine: C:/claude_projects/stoagen-site (directory name predates the repo rename).

THE RULES THAT HOLD. site-src/CLAUDE.md is law: markdown canon with the agent-only marker, superset mirrors, git-derived dates, one script per page (the copy-box enhancer) with content readable JS-off, allow-all robots with Content-Signal all yes, build + validate every time, only main deploys. The field-tested agent laws are in denson/stoagen-com docs/building-agent-friendly-sites.md (two filters: mechanical reachability AND trust; descriptive voice; absolute body-visible URLs; full_site.txt paste line). Author on everything: Denson Smith. Licensed CC BY 4.0 (content) + MIT (code).

STATE AT FILING (2026-08-22). Live, HTTPS enforced, domain verified on GitHub, DNS-only via Cloudflare (never touch Cloudflare without PRINCIPAL's per-instance authorization). 16 pages: home, 12 program pages, programs index, about, agents; start.md front door; copy box on every page. Field-tested end to end with Claude and Gemini. Google Search Console: the apex stoagen.com is registered; the SUBDOMAIN property is NOT yet added (the verification token already serves from this build - one Verify click, then submit sitemap.xml).

KNOWN OPEN ITEMS.
- Search Console property for the subdomain (PRINCIPAL's clicks).
- The questions are personal and transportation-first by design; as PRINCIPAL's questions grow past transportation, pages grow with them. Answers from SRDA get folded back into the pages, dated.
- A standing SRDA Transportation Assessment form was filled for PRINCIPAL on 2026-08-22 (Downloads); the site's questions are meant to be walked into SRDA alongside it.

HANDOFF DISCIPLINE. bw prime at session start. Push tickets with git push origin beadwork (pushing main does not push tickets). On another machine: git fetch origin beadwork:beadwork first. If something goes wrong mid-task, file it here with a concrete next action before stopping; the next seat starts from bw ready.
